Dear Ms. Lopez,

Re: Account ID: ACC-993085

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the debt associated with Account ID: ACC-993085. We understand that you have disputed the debt as "not mine." We will investigate this matter in accordance with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Massachusetts state law.

We have reviewed the account information and found that the original creditor was Liberty Credit Corp. The current balance on this account is $2,903.41. We have also confirmed that the account was charged off on June 3, 2023, and the last payment was made on November 19, 2024.

Pursuant to the FDCPA, we are required to provide you with validation of the debt. However, based on the information provided, it appears that you have not requested validation of the debt. Nevertheless, we will still provide you with information regarding the debt, including the original creditor and the current balance.

We will investigate your dispute and will respond to you in writing with the results of our investigation. If our investigation confirms that the debt is not yours, we will take the necessary steps to remove the debt from your credit report and cease collection efforts.

You have the right to further dispute this debt if you believe it is not yours. Please note that you may also request validation of the debt at any time.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.
